title: RLHND: Video Foundation Models as Physically Grounded Hand Trackers for Robot Learning
title_zh: RLHND：基于视频基础模型、具有物理真实性的手部追踪器，助力机器人学习

paragraphs.en: Recently, approaches that leverage human video datasets for robot policy training have become increasingly prevalent. However, most existing hand trackers regress pose from cropped frames with limited priors on hand motion and object interaction, resulting in inaccurate and physically inconsistent estimates. Moreover, the lack of physical cues, e.g . , contact and force, limits the use of human videos for robot policy training. To this end, we propose RLHND, a video foundation model-based hand tracking model that jointly estimates hand pose and realistic tactile information from monocular egocentric videos. RLHND turns the pre-trained Cosmos 3 video diffusion backbone into a deterministic clip-level feature extractor via clean-latent conditioning, carrying its learned priors on hand motion and hand-object interaction into tracking. For pose estimation, RLHND (i) predicts hand poses with anatomically plausible joint angles and (ii) enables optional conditioning on the shape parameter to maintain consistent hand shape within the same video and even across videos recorded by the same actor. For tactile estimation, a separate tactile expert stream, trained with the pose stream frozen, predicts dense contact and force over the hand surface. We further adopt LBS-based feature spreading to enable vertex-wise feature extraction without costly per-vertex attention. RLHND achieves state-of-the-art performance across various benchmark datasets for pose estimation, while also achieving state-of-the-art performance in contact and force estimation. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of RLHND for robot learning through retargeting results and real-world robot experiments. The code will be publicly available at https://seungjun-moon.github.io/rlhnd/ .
paragraphs.zh: 近期，利用人类视频数据集进行机器人策略训练的方法日益普及。 然而，大多数现有的手部追踪器通过裁剪后的帧来回归姿态，且对手部运动和物体交互的先验知识有限，导致估计结果不准确且物理上不一致。 此外，缺乏接触力和力等物理线索，限制了人类视频在机器人策略训练中的应用。 为此，我们提出了 RLHND——一种基于视频基础模型的手部追踪模型，能够从单目自中心视频中同步估计手部姿态和逼真的触觉信息。 RLHND 通过干净潜变量条件约束，将预训练的 Cosmos 3 视频扩散主干网络转化为一个确定性的片段级特征提取器，将其学习到的手部运动和手-物体交互先验知识融入追踪过程。 在姿态估计方面，RLHND（i）能够预测具有解剖学合理关节角度的手部姿态，并（ii）支持对形状参数进行可选条件约束，从而在同一视频内甚至同一演员拍摄的不同视频中保持手部形状的一致性。 在触觉估计方面，一个独立于姿态流、并在姿态流冻结状态下训练的触觉专家分支，能够预测手部表面的密集接触和力信息。 我们还采用了基于 LBS 的特征传播方法，实现了顶点级的特征提取，而无需耗费大量计算资源的逐顶点注意力机制。 RLHND 在多个基准数据集的姿态度估任务中达到了当前最优性能，同时在接触和力估计方面也取得了当前最优结果。 此外，我们通过结果重定向和真实世界中的机器人实验，展示了 RLHND 在机器人学习中的实用价值。 代码将在 https://seungjun-moon.github.io/rlhnd/ 上公开提供。

paragraphs.en: Along with the rapid advancement of vision-language models ( OpenAI, 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Gemini Team, 2023 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) , robotics foundation models have also made significant progress in recent years ( Brohan et al., 2023 ; Octo Model Team et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2024 ; Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Bjorck et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026b ) . However, robotics datasets remain substantially more limited in scale than vision-language datasets and are considerably more labor-intensive to collect. Recently, researchers have recognized the potential of human egocentric videos, which are relatively easy to collect and can capture a wide range of tasks that are difficult to demonstrate through teleoperation. Consequently, human datasets ( Grauman et al., 2022 ; Banerjee et al., 2024 ; Hoque et al., 2026 ) have been increasingly leveraged to train robotics foundation models ( Ye et al., 2025a ; Kareer et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 随着视觉语言模型（OpenAI, 2023；Liu 等，2023；Gemini Team, 2023；Bai 等，2025）的快速发展，机器人基础模型近年来也取得了显著进展（Brohan 等，2023；Octo Model Team 等，2024；Kim 等，2024；Black 等，2024；Physical Intelligence 等，2025；Bjorck 等，2025；Kim 等，2026b）。 然而，机器人数据集的规模仍远小于视觉语言数据集，且其收集过程也更为劳动密集。 最近，研究人员认识到第一人称视角视频所蕴含的潜力：这类视频相对易于收集，并能捕捉到许多难以通过远程操作演示的任务。 因此，人类活动数据集（Grauman 等，2022；Banerjee 等，2024；Hoque 等，2026）正被越来越多地用于训练机器人基础模型（Ye 等，2025a；Kareer 等，2024；Yang 等，2025；Luo 等，2025；Kim 等，2026b）。

paragraphs.en: However, utilizing human videos for robot training requires bridging two major gaps between human videos and real-world robot episodes. The first is the action-space discrepancy between humans and robots. Existing works address this discrepancy by retargeting human hand motion to a specific robot embodiment ( Handa et al., 2020 ; Qin et al., 2023 ; Shaw et al., 2022 ; Lepert et al., 2025 ) , defining a co-action space that encompasses both human and robot joint actions ( Kareer et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , or adopting an end-effector-based action space consisting of wrist poses and keypoints ( Haldar & Pinto, 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026a ; Cai et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，利用人类视频进行机器人训练需要弥合人类视频与真实世界机器人体验之间的两个主要差距。 第一个差距是人类与机器人之间的动作空间差异。 现有研究通过以下方式解决这一差异：将人类手部运动重新映射到特定的机器人形态（Handa et al., 2020 ; Qin et al., 2023 ; Shaw et al., 2022 ; Lepert et al., 2025）；定义一个同时涵盖人类和机器人关节动作的协同动作空间（Kareer et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025）；或采用基于末端执行器的动作空间，该空间由手腕姿态和关键点组成（Haldar & Pinto, 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026a ; Cai et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Regardless of the choice of action space, these approaches require human action labels that provide 3D hand joint locations. However, existing hand motion reconstruction methods are often optimized primarily for 2D reprojection or image-space alignment, which can make their 3D predictions unreliable for robot action labeling. As shown in Figure 1 , existing hand reconstructions exhibit severe jitter along the depth axis (left), while the estimated size of the same hand can fluctuate substantially across frames (right). The latter arises from the inherent scale-depth ambiguity under perspective projection, where depth errors can be absorbed into the estimated hand shape. Such temporally inconsistent and physically implausible 3D trajectories are problematic for robot learning, where small errors in motion estimation can lead to substantially different or infeasible actions.
paragraphs.zh: 无论动作空间如何选择，这些方法都需要提供三维手部关节位置的人类动作标签。 然而，现有的手部运动重建方法通常主要针对二维重投影或图像空间对齐进行优化，这可能导致其三维预测在机器人动作标注中不可靠。 如图 1 所示，现有的人手重建结果在深度轴方向上存在严重的抖动（左图），而同一只手估计的尺寸在不同帧之间也可能出现大幅波动（右图）。 后一种问题源于透视投影下固有的尺度-深度歧义，其中深度误差可能会被吸收进估计的手部形状中。 这类在时间上不一致且物理上不合理三维轨迹会给机器人学习带来问题，因为运动估计中的微小误差就可能导致动作结果大相径庭甚至无法执行。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we present RLHND, which produces both metrically accurate, anatomically realistic 3D bimanual hand motion and dense contact and force estimates over the hand surface from a monocular human video. Since recent works ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) show that pre-trained video diffusion models internalize strong priors on hand-object interactions, RLHND uses Cosmos 3 Nano ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) as its video feature encoder. Unlike Liu et al. (2026) , which feeds clean videos directly into a denoising backbone, we instead route them through the conditioning-frame interface of Cosmos 3, which is designed to receive clean context frames during pre-training. This design keeps our fine-tuning aligned with the pre-trained interface of the backbone.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 RLHND，它能够通过单目人类视频生成既在度量上准确、又在解剖学上逼真的三维双手运动，并估算出手部表面的密集接触和力。 由于近期的研究（Wang et al., 2026；Liu et al., 2026）表明，预训练的 видео扩散模型内部已经形成了关于手与物体交互的强先验知识，因此 RLHND 使用 Cosmos 3 Nano（NVIDIA, 2026）作为其视频特征编码器。与 Liu et al. （2026）不同，后者将干净的视频直接输入到去噪主干网络中，而我们则将其通过 Cosmos 3 的条件帧接口进行传输，该接口在预训练期间被设计为接收干净上下文帧。 这种设计使我们的微调与主干网络的预训练接口保持一致。

paragraphs.en: On top of the Cosmos 3 encoder, we make three design choices motivated by real-world deployment. (i) Shape caching. RLHND caches the shape parameter and uses a single value throughout the entire video. This not only eliminates the hand-size fluctuations shown in Figure 1 , but also allows direct injection of a pre-calibrated 𝜷 \bm{\beta} , which is particularly useful in real-world data collection settings where the hand shape of the operator is known. (ii) Anatomical pose parameterization. Rather than regressing the 45 45 rotational DoF of MANO, we align each joint with its anatomical axes and freeze the axes about which a human finger cannot rotate, regressing 29 29 DoF. (iii) A decoupled tactile expert. Contact and force are predicted by a second expert stream that is trained with the pose stream frozen, so tactile supervision never perturbs the pose. paragraphs.en: We extend video foundation model-based hand tracking beyond pose estimation: RLHND leverages the clean-latent conditioning interface of Cosmos 3 to extract rich spatiotemporal representations from monocular video and jointly estimates metrically accurate bimanual motion with dense contact and force over the hand surface.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将基于视频基础模型的手部跟踪扩展到了姿态估计之外：RLHND 利用 Cosmos 3 的纯净潜在条件接口，从单目视频中提取丰富的时空表示，并联合估计出具有度量精度、包含手部表面密集接触与力的双手运动。

paragraphs.en: We achieve state-of-the-art performance in both hand motion reconstruction and tactile estimation, enabled by physically grounded design choices including cached hand shape, anatomically constrained pose, and a decoupled tactile expert with LBS-based feature spreading.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过基于物理的设计选择，包括缓存的手部形状、具有解剖学约束的姿势以及采用LBS基特征传播的解耦触觉专家模型，在手部运动重建和触觉估计两个方面均实现了当前最先进的性能。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate the utility of RLHND for robot learning: its outputs yield accurate and smooth retargeted commands across five dexterous hands and enable training Dexterous Point Policy from human demonstrations with automatically labeled contact.

paragraphs.en: Hand motion reconstruction methods have been developed to improve both pose accuracy and temporal consistency. The primary approach uses image-based methods ( Pavlakos et al., 2024 ; Potamias et al., 2024 ) , which regress MANO ( Romero et al., 2017 ) parameters from a cropped image input by a hand detection model ( Potamias et al., 2024 ) . Since they treat every frame independently, they cannot consider any temporal consistency among frames. In contrast, video-based methods ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025b ; Xu et al., 2026 ) add temporal context either by fusing crop features across frames ( Ye et al., 2025b ) or by tracking the hand and the camera in a world frame ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . Despite this, their reliance on per-frame crops causes them to inherit detector box jitter and remain only weakly consistent over time. Most recently, models built on video foundation backbones take the entire clip as input and infer over both hands jointly ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , which notably improves temporal coherence. Even these models, however, regress a hand shape per window, leading to temporal variation in the estimated hand size, while the scale-depth ambiguity of perspective projection allows depth errors to manifest as variations in the estimated shape. RLHND keeps the clip-level formulation but fixes a single shape per video and constrains the pose to the anatomical degrees of freedom, which removes both failure modes.
paragraphs.zh: 手部动作重建方法已经得到发展，旨在同时提升姿态准确性和时间一致性。 主要方法采用基于图像的方法（Pavlakos 等人，2024；Potamias 等人，2024），通过手部检测模型（Potamias 等人，2024）裁剪出的图像输入，回归 MANO（Romero 等人，2017）参数。 由于这些方法将每一帧独立处理，因此无法考虑帧之间的时间一致性。 相比之下，基于视频的方法（Zhang 等人，2025；Ye 等人，2025b；Xu 等人，2026）通过融合跨帧的裁剪特征（Ye 等人，2025b），或在世界坐标系中跟踪手和相机（Zhang 等人，2025；Xu 等人，2026），来引入时间上下文信息。 尽管如此，由于这些方法依赖每帧的独立裁剪，它们继承了检测框的抖动问题，并且在时间上的一致性仍然较弱。 最近，基于视频基础背骨模型将整个视频片段作为输入，并联合推断双手的姿态（Wang 等人，2026；Liu 等人，2026），这显著提升了时间连贯性。 然而，即使这些模型也为每个窗口回归一个手型，导致估计的手部尺寸出现时间上的变化；同时，透视投影的尺度-深度歧义使得深度误差可能表现为估计形状的变化。 RLHND 保留了片段级的建模框架，但为整个视频固定了单一的手型，并将姿态约束在解剖学自由度范围内，从而消除了这两种失效模式。

paragraphs.en: Unlike motion reconstruction, force labels require specialized hardware, e.g . , pressure boards ( Grady et al., 2022 ) or tactile gloves ( Song et al., 2025 ) . PressureVisionDB ( Grady et al., 2022 ) records RGB video of a bare hand pressing a planar capacitive pad, providing dense and finely resolved pressure maps that are spatially limited to the palm-pad contact region. OpenTouch ( Song et al., 2025 ) instead moves the sensor onto the hand, pairing in-the-wild egocentric video with a 16 × 16 16{\times}16 taxel grid on the palmar side of a wearable glove, enabling force measurements during natural manipulation of diverse objects. EgoPressure ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) extends pressure sensing to egocentric video with multi-view MANO fits, while EgoTactile ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) provides full-hand glove pressure on 63 63 everyday objects and a bare-hand subset. However, differences in sensor calibration and hand-surface correspondence make it difficult to pool these datasets without converting their labels to a common representation. For contact estimation, tactile hardware is not required: HACO ( Jung & Lee, 2025 ) generates hand contact labels from the distances between hand and object meshes in HOI datasets and uses them to train contact estimation models. For force estimation, however, such geometric supervision is insufficient, requiring datasets with physical force measurements. HOPE ( Jeon et al., 2026 ) unifies contact and force labels from pressure boards and tactile gloves on the MANO surface, enabling joint learning of contact and force estimation. RLHND follows the unified label format of HOPE while introducing a decoupled tactile expert, achieving improved tactile estimation performance.

paragraphs.en: Given a monocular video, RLHND estimates both hand pose and tactile signals. The video is processed as a sequence of W W clips 𝒞 1 , … , 𝒞 W \mathcal{C}_{1},\dots,\mathcal{C}_{W} , each holding T T consecutive frames 𝒞 w = ( 𝐈 t ) t = 1 T \mathcal{C}_{w}=(\mathbf{I}_{t})_{t=1}^{T} . The pose output consists of MANO ( Romero et al., 2017 ) parameters, i.e . , shape 𝜷 ^ w ∈ ℝ 10 \hat{\bm{\beta}}^{w}\in\mathbb{R}^{10} and anatomically constrained articulation 𝜽 ^ t \hat{\bm{\theta}}_{t} with the global wrist rotation, along with metric camera-space translation 𝝉 ^ t ∈ ℝ 3 \hat{\bm{\tau}}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} and per-frame hand presence and visibility. The tactile output consists of per-vertex tactile signals: contact probability 𝐜 ^ t ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] | V | \hat{\mathbf{c}}_{t}\in[0,1]^{|V|} and force 𝐟 ^ t ∈ ℝ ≥ 0 | V | \hat{\mathbf{f}}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}^{|V|} , where | V | = 778 |V|=778 is the number of MANO vertices. The RLHND architecture consists of three parts: the clean-latent encoder converts a pre-trained video-diffusion backbone into a deterministic video feature extractor, the pose expert stream predicts pose, shape, and translation in MANO parameter form from the video features, and the tactile expert stream estimates contact and force from the same video features with its own weights, trained with the pose stream frozen, thereby decoupling tactile prediction from pose prediction. paragraphs.en: Dexterous Point Policy ( Kim et al., 2026a ) , i.e . , DPP, trains robot policies from human demonstrations using keypoint locations and fingertip contact labels for force application, with the latter manually annotated for each demonstration. RLHND provides both automatically from a single model, with fingertip keypoints from its pose stream and contact labels from its contact head. paragraphs.en: We presented RLHND, a physically grounded hand tracker built on a pre-trained video foundation model for robot learning. It achieves state-of-the-art motion reconstruction and tactile estimation, produces smooth retargeted commands across five dexterous hands, and lets Dexterous Point Policy outperform its original tracker without manual annotation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 RLHND，这是一种基于预训练视频基础模型、专为机器人学习设计的物理驱动型手部追踪器。 它实现了当前最先进的运动重建和触觉估计，能够跨五只灵巧手生成平滑的重定向指令，并让 Dexterous Point Policy 无需人工标注即可超越其原始追踪器。

paragraphs.en: RLHND uses only publicly released human hand-object datasets under their respective licenses and consent procedures. We collect no new human data and release no raw video. Since the method can recover fine-grained hand activity from ordinary footage, including egocentric recordings containing bystanders, we intend it for robot learning from consenting demonstrators and discourage surveillance use. Contact and force are inferred rather than measured, so we recommend joint-torque or current limits and human supervision when deploying retargeted commands. Finally, the limited diversity of public datasets may lead to performance variation across subjects, hand sizes, and skin tones that is not captured by our evaluation sets. The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
paragraphs.zh: RLHND 仅使用已公开发布的人类手-物体数据集，并遵循其各自的许可协议和同意程序。 我们不收集任何新的人类数据，也不发布任何原始视频。 由于该方法能够从普通视频中恢复精细的手部活动，包括包含旁观者的第一人称视角录像，因此我们将其用于机器人从获得同意的演示者处学习，并反对将其用于监控目的。 接触和力是通过推断而非直接测量获得的，因此在部署重新定向的命令时，我们建议设置关节扭矩或电流限制，并由人类进行监督。 最后，公开数据集的多样性有限，可能导致不同受试者、手型和肤色之间的性能差异，而这些差异在我们的评估集中并未体现。 作者声明不存在利益冲突。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 details the inference-time shape protocol of Section 3.2 . Videos are decoded clip by clip until the first sufficiently visible clip 𝒞 w ∗ \mathcal{C}_{w^{*}} is found, whose shape-head output becomes 𝜷 cache \bm{\beta}_{\mathrm{cache}} and is reused for all clips; previously probed clips are then decoded again with the cached shape. If no clip qualifies, each clip retains its own shape estimate, corresponding to the per-clip setting in Table 1 . With an externally calibrated shape, the algorithm starts with 𝜷 cache \bm{\beta}_{\mathrm{cache}} initialized and decodes every clip once without probing. Figure 5 illustrates this procedure on a test recording, where the first well-visible window supplies the shape shared by the entire video.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 详细描述了第 3.2 节中推理时的形状协议。 视频按片段逐一解码，直到找到第一个足够清晰的片段 𝒞 w ∗ \mathcal{C}_{w^{*}}；该片段形状头的输出结果将作为 𝜷 cache \bm{\beta}_{\mathrm{cache}} 被重复用于所有片段，而之前探测过的片段则使用缓存的形状重新解码。 如果没有片段符合标准，每个片段都将保留其自身的形状估计值，这与表 1 中的按片段设置相对应。 在拥有外部校准的形状后，算法会先初始化 𝜷 cache \bm{\beta}_{\mathrm{cache}}，然后无需探测即可对每个片段进行一次解码。 图 5 展示了这一流程在一个测试录像中的应用，其中第一个清晰可见的窗口提供了整个视频共享的形状信息。

paragraphs.en: We convert only the MANO parameters and leave all 2D and 3D keypoint labels unchanged. Most of our sources obtain 3D keypoints first, e.g . , from marker-based motion capture, multi-view triangulation, or a head-mounted device, and fit MANO to these keypoints afterwards. Thus, the anatomically infeasible twist and spread angles in the original MANO labels arise from the unconstrained MANO fitting rather than from the keypoint annotations themselves, as the fitting process can use the extra DoF of MANO to absorb residual keypoint error. Refitting the keypoints to the constrained MANO would moreover alter the ground truth against which every method is evaluated, reducing benchmark reproducibility and potentially tailoring the evaluation to our parameterization. Keeping the original keypoints therefore ensures that all comparisons in Section 4 remain against the datasets as released.
paragraphs.zh: 我们仅转换 MANO 参数，而保留所有 2D 和 3D 关键点标签不变。 我们的大部分数据源首先获取 3D 关键点，例如通过基于标记的动作捕捉、多视角三角测量或头戴式设备获取，然后再将这些关键点拟合到 MANO 上。 因此，原始 MANO 标签中那些在解剖学上不合理的扭转和展开角度，源于无约束的 MANO 拟合过程，而非关键点标注本身，因为拟合过程可以利用 MANO 的额外自由度来吸收残留的关键点误差。 此外，若将关键点重新拟合到受约束的 MANO 上，将会改变所有方法评估所依据的真实数据，从而降低基准测试的可重复性，并可能使评估结果偏向于我们的参数化方式。 因此，保留原始关键点可确保第 4 节中的所有比较均基于已发布的原始数据集进行。

paragraphs.en: Since the glove signal drifts and does not return to zero between grasps, HOPE gates it using a per-clip frame state. paragraphs.en: We run every baseline with its official code and released weights on exactly the frames we score, rather than quoting published numbers. This ensures that all methods are evaluated on the same frames. The crop-based per-frame trackers HaMeR ( Pavlakos et al., 2024 ) , WiLoR ( Potamias et al., 2024 ) , HaWoR ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and HaPTIC ( Ye et al., 2025b ) share the hand detector released with WiLoR and the detection logic introduced in HaWoR. The detector selects the highest-confidence box per side and mirrors left hands to the right-hand model. Their F Acc therefore coincides, and their “-p” metrics use the same detection front-end. HandFlow ( Xu et al., 2026 ) is run through its released pipeline. Since it has no 2D head, EPE2D-p uses its reprojected joints, and camera translation is obtained from its crop-based weak-perspective lift. ACE-Ego-Hand ( Liu et al., 2026 ) is run with its official inference code and checkpoint. We use one forward pass per test window at the protocol resolution with the released MANO decode and camera solver.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用每个基线方法的官方代码和已发布的权重，在与我们评分完全相同的帧上运行测试，而不是引用已发表的数值。 这确保了所有方法都在相同的帧上进行评估。 基于裁剪的每帧追踪器 HaMeR（Pavlakos 等，2024）、WiLoR（Potamias 等，2024）、HaWoR（Zhang 等，2025）和 HaPTIC（Ye 等，2025b）共享 WiLoR 发布的手部检测器和 HaWoR 引入的检测逻辑。 该检测器为每侧选择置信度最高的边界框，并将左手镜像转换到右手模型中。 因此，它们的 F Acc 一致，且它们的“-p”指标使用了相同的检测前端。 HandFlow（Xu 等，2026）通过其已发布的流程管道运行。 由于它没有二维头部，EPE2D-p 使用其重投影后的关节点，而相机平移则通过其基于裁剪的弱透视提升获得。 ACE-Ego-Hand（Liu 等，2026）使用其官方推理代码和检查点运行。 我们以协议分辨率对每个测试窗口执行一次前向传播，并使用已发布的 MANO 解码器和相机求解器。

paragraphs.en: Packing and objective. Episodes are resampled to 20 20 fps, and each observation is represented in the camera frame of its anchor step relative to a per-episode origin. The observation consists of 18 18 tokens of width 512 512 , comprising up to four objects represented by 512 512 stereo points each, together with MiniLM embeddings of the instruction and object names, the 42 42 hand keypoints, and the 9 9 -D camera pose. Object points are obtained from Fast-FoundationStereo ( Wen et al., 2025a ) depth and SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) masks. The action is a 16 16 -step chunk, i.e . , 0.8 0.8 s, of keypoint displacements, normalized per step and channel using the statistics of the DPP pre-training corpus and clipped to ± 5 \pm 5 . The objective is rectified flow, implemented as an MSE on the velocity between Gaussian noise and the target, masked when a hand is not tracked, together with a BCE loss on the 42 42 contact logits computed from detached features so that the contact loss does not backpropagate into the trunk.
paragraphs.zh: 打包与目标。 剧集被重采样为 20 20 fps，每个观察值都在其锚定步的相机帧中表示，相对于每集的原点。 观察值由 18 18 个宽度为 512 512 的标记组成，包括最多四个物体（每个物体由 512 512 个立体点表示），以及指令和物体名称的 MiniLM 嵌入、42 42 个手部关键点和 9 9 -D 相机姿态。 物体点来自 Fast-FoundationStereo (Wen et al., 2025a) 的深度数据和 SAM 3 (Carion et al., 2025) 的掩码。 动作是一个 16 16 步的片段（即 0.8 0.8 秒），包含关键点位移，这些位移按步和通道使用 DPP 预训练语料库的统计数据进行归一化，并裁剪至 ± 5 \pm 5。 目标是校正流，实现为高斯噪声与目标之间的速度上的 MSE，当手部未被跟踪时进行掩码处理，同时还包括从分离特征中计算的 42 42 个接触 logits 上的 BCE 损失，以确保接触损失不会反向传播到主干网络中。

paragraphs.en: Optimization. Every policy starts from the same DiT-B checkpoint pretrained for 100 100 k steps and is fine-tuned for 60 60 k steps with AdamW using a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , 1 1 k warm-up steps followed by a constant learning rate, gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 , batch size 128 128 , dropout 0.1 0.1 , and bf16 autocast on a single A100, which takes 60 60 - 90 90 minutes per training each policy. Snapshots are saved every 10 10 k steps, and the 60 60 k snapshot is used for deployment with 6 6 Euler steps from Gaussian noise.
paragraphs.zh: 优化。 所有策略均从相同的 DiT-B 检查点开始，该检查点已预训练 100,000 步，并通过 AdamW 进行 60,000 步的微调，学习率为 10⁻⁴，权重衰减为 10⁻⁴，包含 1,000 步预热阶段，随后采用恒定学习率，梯度裁剪值为 1.0，批量大小为 128，丢弃率为 0.1，并在单个 A100 上启用 bf16 自动类型转换；每训练一个策略需要 60-90 分钟。 快照每 10,000 步保存一次，其中第 60,000 步的快照用于部署，并通过高斯噪声进行 6 个欧拉步生成。

paragraphs.en: Figure 12 compares the wrist depth of the two trackers with the stereo depth that the DPP pipeline aligns them to. Even before the alignment, RLHND already follows the stereo trajectory closely. Over the 200 200 demonstrations, its right-wrist depth deviates from the stereo target by a median of 2.3 2.3 cm, which is 17.8% lower than HaWoR’s. In both cases the deviation is dominated by a constant offset, with a median bias of + 2.2 +2.2 cm for RLHND and + 2.6 +2.6 cm for HaWoR, whereas the frame-to-frame errors are visibly smaller for RLHND during fast reaching motions. Since the alignment only rescales each frame and leaves the temporal noise of the tracker in place, the residual error is also smaller for RLHND after the per-frame alignment, e.g . , at 0.1 0.1 cm against 0.2 0.2 cm. The remaining offset is largely a scale-depth ambiguity of the monocular hand, so it can be reduced further by measuring the actor’s hand once and running RLHND with a pre-defined 𝜷 cache \bm{\beta}_{\mathrm{cache}} , which fixes the hand size and therefore the depth. We nevertheless apply the same alignment to both sources, so that Table 4 compares the trackers rather than their depth scale.
paragraphs.zh: 图 12 将两种追踪器的腕部深度与 DPP 流程对其的立体深度进行了比较。 即使在对齐之前，RLHND 已经能够紧密跟随立体轨迹。 在 200 次演示中，其右腕深度与立体目标的中位数偏差为 2.3 厘米，比 HaWoR 低 17.8%。 在这两种情况下，偏差主要由一个恒定偏移量主导：RLHND 的中位数偏差为 +2.2 厘米，而 HaWoR 则为 +2.6 厘米；相比之下，在快速伸手动作中，RLHND 的帧间误差明显更小。 由于对齐过程仅对每帧进行重新缩放，并未消除追踪器的时间噪声，因此在每帧对齐后，RLHND 的残余误差也更小，例如为 0.1 厘米，而 HaWoR 则为 0.2 厘米。 剩余的偏移量主要源于单目手部深度与尺度之间的模糊性，因此可以通过对演员的手部进行一次测量，并使用预定义的 𝜷 缓存 \bm{\beta}_{\mathrm{cache}} 运行 RLHND 来进一步减小该误差，从而固定手部尺寸及深度。 尽管如此，我们对两种输入源都应用了相同的对齐方式，因此表 4 比较的是追踪器本身，而非它们的深度尺度。

paragraphs.en: HOPE ( Jeon et al., 2026 ) ablates the inputs of its vertex transformer and reports that combining visual features with hand pose outperforms either alone, suggesting that the two provide complementary information for contact and pressure estimation. Our expert already receives pose information indirectly, as its bone tokens are initialized from the pose decoder and spread to vertices through the MANO skinning weights. We therefore test whether directly attending to the pose tokens provides additional information. We implement this as one-way attention, where the expert’s bone tokens take the pose tokens as additional keys and values, while the pose tokens never attend back. Thus, the frozen stage-1 stream remains unchanged by the tactile objective and the pose predictions are bit-identical. paragraphs.en: The 𝜷 \bm{\beta} -cache is designed around a hand shape measured once per operator, which is natural in robot data collection but unavailable on public benchmarks without per-subject calibration. We therefore initialize the cache from the first well-visible window on these benchmarks, and can demonstrate the benefit of external calibration only using the ground-truth 𝜷 \bm{\beta} available in ARCTIC (A4 in Table 5 ). paragraphs.en: Force supervision in our training data comes from a single tactile glove (OpenTouch) and a single planar pressure pad (PressureVisionDB), limiting the diversity of pressure magnitudes and contact surfaces seen during training. Newer datasets such as EgoPressure ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) provide additional egocentric pressure data, but incorporating them requires reconciling their sensor calibration, surface parameterization, and contact definitions with those of existing datasets. Until tactile datasets adopt more consistent surface representations and pressure units, scaling force supervision across heterogeneous sensors remains challenging.
paragraphs.zh: 我们训练数据中的力监督仅来自一个触觉手套（OpenTouch）和一个平面压力传感器（PressureVisionDB），这限制了训练过程中所接触的压力大小和接触面的多样性。 EgoPressure（Zhao 等人，2025）等较新的数据集提供了额外的以自我为中心的压力数据，但要将其纳入训练，需要将这些数据的传感器校准、表面参数化和接触定义与现有数据集的相应部分进行协调统一。 在触觉数据集采用更一致的表面表示和压力单位之前，跨异构传感器实现力监督的扩展仍然具有挑战性。

paragraphs.en: Accurate hand motion and contact labels do not directly determine robot actions. Our real-robot experiments use a fixed inverse-kinematics retargeting procedure with locked abduction joints and a heuristic contact offset, while the retargeting results in Table 3 measure fidelity to a solver applied to the ground-truth hand rather than task success. Mapping human hand motion and contact patterns to dexterous hands with different kinematics, contact geometry, and compliance, as well as exploiting predicted force beyond binary contact, remains outside the scope of this work. Finally, RLHND processes clips offline rather than in real time, and its backbone is substantially larger than crop-based regressors.
paragraphs.zh: 精确的手部运动和接触标签并不直接决定机器人的动作。 我们的真实机器人实验采用固定的逆运动学重映射流程，其中外展关节被锁定，并应用启发式接触偏移；而表3中的重映射结果衡量的是对真实手部数据的求解器结果的忠实度，而非任务的成功率。 将人类的手部运动和接触模式映射到具有不同运动学特性、接触几何形状和柔顺性的灵巧手，以及利用预测力超越二元接触状态，仍属于本研究范围之外的问题。 最后，RLHND 以离线方式处理视频片段，而非实时处理，且其核心模型规模远大于基于裁剪的回归模型。
